title: Velvet Jellied Wrap
description: A unique dessert made with edible gelatin, velvet, and a gluten-free wrap.
instructions: Bloom the gelatin by soaking it in water for 5 minutes.
Add sugar and lemon juice to the gelatin mixture and stir until dissolved.
Pour the gelatin mixture into a baking dish and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Cut the gluten-free wrap into small pieces and add to the gelatin mixture.
Pour in the velvet and mix well.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large mold.
Refrigerate for an additional 30 minutes or until set.
